points.statement: The aim is for coordination to expose the task consequence of a private fact: who acts, what crosses the handoff boundary, where it goes, and what follows.
points.quote: Coordination must reveal the task consequence of a private fact: who acts, what crosses the handoff boundary, where it goes, and which suffix follows.

points.statement: The task consequence itself becomes the object of coordination.
points.quote: makes the consequence itself the coordination object

points.statement: A consequence local to the sender moves forward in a peer request, and the receiver then generates its downstream skill path.
points.quote: A sender-local consequence travels forward inside a peer request, after which the receiver generates its downstream skill path.

points.statement: A capability consequence local to the peer returns through bounded feedback, and the requester then revises how work is divided.
points.quote: A peer-local capability consequence travels back through bounded feedback, after which the requester revises the division of work.

points.statement: An explicit object whose meaning survives communication, resolution, and execution is needed in both directions.
points.quote: Both directions require one explicit object whose semantics survive communication, resolution, and execution.

points.statement: It composes goals, capabilities, objects, history, messages, and shared task structure into role-local paths of varying length.
points.quote: compose goals, capabilities, objects, history, received messages, and shared task structure into variable-length role-local paths.

points.statement: Following resolution, the same schema holds the role-local obligations that proceed into execution.
points.quote: after resolution the same schema carries the role-local obligations that enter execution.

points.statement: The resolved object is parsed, schema-checked, canonically materialized, and compiled into skills.
points.quote: parse, schema check, canonical materialization, skill compilation
